push.title: W 5-3 vs BaIIhog Fc | You: 9.6 (4th best match performance)
push.body:
Well, saddle up and ride, PhogsToffees. A 9.6 is your 4th best match performance.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at BaIIhog Fc's goal. You were knocking on that door like you were selling encyclopedias.
+ 2 key passes. Chance creation is generosity with a soccer ball.
+ Man of the Match, your 8th for us. Man of the Match means everybody noticed, including me.
+ Match rating 9.6, up from your usual 7.4. That's what showing up looks like.
+ You saw buddskees's run before buddskees did.

THE BAD
- Most misplaced passes on the team: 6 (best was buddskees's 4). It's a small thing until it's the whole thing.
- Shots on target: 67%. Top tier forwards post 90%+. Let's join 'em.

Homework: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.

PhogsToffees, one more thing before you log off: Smile at the goalkeeper. It confuses 'em.

Good game, great person, bright future. - Coach Lasso

+ A hat trick against BaIIhog Fc, a new personal best. Cool as the other side of the pillow.
+ You and PhogsToffees had more chemistry than a high school lab.
+ 1.0 up on your usual. Step by step, you're getting there.
+ Fewest misplaced passes on the team (4). You earned that one the honest way.

- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 19 (best was PhogsToffees's 30). We can fix that.
- Most missed tackles on the team: 1 (best was PhogsToffees's 0). That's the kind of number that loses matches.
- 3 goals conceded: -0.1. Don't sweat it, fix it.

Drill: Receive on the half-turn so your first touch can go forward.

buddskees, something I want you to sleep on: Win the next five seconds, then the next five.

Same time, same energy, next match. - Coach Lasso

A 7.6 from you, BellyTb1. Steady hands, clear head. We'll build on that.

+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). You're the reason the forwards have something to celebrate.
+ You set it up, buddskees knocked it down. Repeat as needed.
+ Pass accuracy 79%, up from your usual 66%. Pure hustle, and hustle is free.
+ Their humans averaged 7.4 to our 8.8; we out-played them man for man. Moments like that are why we keep showing up.
+ Match rating 7.6, from 5.9 in your previous match. That doesn't happen by accident.

- No tackles attempted. Key note: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost. Bread and butter.
- Rating came in 0.7 below what your on-ball stats earned. Repeat after me: Hold your spot in the shape when the ball's on the far side. Drifting leaves the back line naked.
- Lowest goals on the team: 0 (best was buddskees's 3). Numbers don't lie, even when we wish they would.
- Lowest on-ball actions on the team: 25 (best was PhogsToffees's 35). That's the gap between a good night and a great one.
- 3 goals conceded: -0.1. Next match, nail it.

Practice this: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.

Before you go, BellyTb1: Hope is a plan with its shoes untied. Tie 'em.

You've got more in you. I've seen it. - Coach Lasso
